lines.zh: 我抱着个罐子，跳得很小心。
lines.en: I hop carefully, a jar in my arms.
Each step light, afraid to break it.
Something rattles inside the jar.

lines.zh: 我走在队伍后面，离远点。
lines.en: I walk at the back, well apart.
My kin keep their distance from me.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，挑干的地方。
lines.en: I go around puddles, taking the dry ground.
One hand under, one on the rim.
I hop, and the jar sloshes.

lines.zh: 沼泽的气味很重，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The marsh stinks. I don't like it.
I glance at the wall ahead.
From here I can throw it.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把罐子抱稳。
lines.en: Step by step, keeping the jar steady.
Soft mud underfoot. I go slow.
I'm looking for open space.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，把罐子放在膝上。
lines.en: I squat and rest the jar on my knee.

lines.zh: 我摇了摇，听听里面的声音。
lines.en: I shake it and listen.
This much will open a wall.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔手指，抹在引线上。
lines.en: I wet a finger and run it along the fuse.
I work out the wind, and which way to run.
My hide is thick. Heat doesn't worry me.
The village lamps are still on.
My bombs are packed wet mud.

lines.zh: 我把它放在地上，又抱起来。
lines.en: I set it down, then pick it up again.
Nobody wants this job. I do it.

lines.zh: 我的肚子鼓起来，又瘪下去。
lines.en: My throat swells and goes flat.
Fog this thick will damp the fuse.

lines.zh: 我把它挪到干一点的地方。
lines.en: I move it somewhere drier.
Wait. Not time yet.
Don't come this close!

lines.zh: 我手上抱着东西，你退开。
lines.en: I'm carrying something. Get back.

lines.zh: 你要是碰我，我们俩都得飞。
lines.en: Touch me and we both go up.
Stand over there. Further.

lines.zh: 我举了举罐子，你就懂了。
lines.en: I lift the jar. You'll understand.
I really don't want to go off here.
Are you holding fire?
Don't throw anything this way.

lines.zh: 我背着的炸弹，可不是玩具。
lines.en: The bomb on my back isn't a toy.
I'm not easy about this job.
I'll count to three. You'd better be gone.
My hands are shaking. Don't push me.
Why are you standing so close?

lines.zh: 我抱着的这个，比我有用。
lines.en: What I'm holding matters more than me.
What are you laughing at? It isn't funny.
Don't move. I can't hold it steady.
Don't touch me! It'll go off!
I clutched it. It didn't fall.
My arm was struck. I still didn't let go.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，把罐子压在身下。
lines.en: I crouch and shield the jar with my body.
This much pain I can bear.

lines.zh: 我退开几步，离你们远点。
lines.en: I back off, away from all of you.
Blood on the jar. I wipe it.
If I don't make it, run.
Don't come to help me up.
I can still carry it.
I can't take anything right now.

lines.zh: 你把吃的搁石头上，退开。
lines.en: Set the food on the stone and step back.
Eating makes my hands shake. No.
Put it further off. The jar breaks easily.

lines.zh: 我闻得到，但我不能分心。
lines.en: I can smell it. I can't get distracted.
After this job, I'll eat.
Too close. Back up.
I'm shaking my head. Don't insist.
That much would last me two days.
At dawn I'll come back for it.
Don't touch me — the jar will blow!
You bumped me and I clutched the jar.
Neither of us moves.
That was close.

lines.zh: 我把它护在怀里，往后退。
lines.en: I shield it against my chest and back away.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我差点松手。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot and I nearly dropped it.
Mud's slick. Steady me.
Go around me. I can't be crowded.
There's fire on me.
Let's separate. Slowly.
This work… doesn't allow that.
My chances of surviving aren't good.
Find someone else.

lines.zh: 我抱着的这个，就是我的命。
lines.en: What I hold is my life.
If I don't come back… never mind.
Staying away from me is a good thing.
With the jar against my chest, I dare not sit.
I don't want to drag anyone with me.
Stand there and don't speak.
This is fine too.
I haven't a hand free.

lines.zh: 我脚尖一勾，把它勾到脚边。
lines.en: One flick of my toe hooks it to my feet.

lines.zh: 炸开村庄，这就是我的活。
lines.en: Blowing up villages is my line of work.
This could serve as tinder.

lines.zh: 我夹在胳膊和罐子之间。
lines.en: I wedge it between my arm and the jar.
Dropped it. I daren't bend.
Yours. I kick it back.
I pin it underfoot and remember it.
This mustn't touch fire.

lines.zh: 我把它丢到远一点的地方。
lines.en: I toss it further off.
That wall — I can reach it.
First, find the wind.
I raise an arm to gauge the distance.
The village square is empty.
I'm waiting for the signal.
My kin are at the wall already.
The wind blows toward the village; I steady the jar.
I raise the jar overhead.
One step closer and I throw.

lines.zh: 别挡在我前面，蛙村就在下面。
lines.en: Do not stand in my way; the frog village is below.

lines.zh: 我一直举着，手臂有点酸。
lines.en: I keep it raised. My arm aches.
I let go on three.
Someone's watching from the wall.
I shift a step to the left.

lines.zh: 我抱着罐子，跳得很小心。
lines.en: I hop carefully, clutching the jar.
Someone's shouting up ahead.
I crouch and set the jar low.
From here I can make the throw.
I hear the fuse.
One. Two. I'm counting.
I threw the jar.
The moment it leaves my hand, I run.
That will open the wall.
Held it so long my fingers locked.
Fire blooms not far off.
The shockwave knocks me down. I crawl.
One more jar. One more chance.

lines.zh: 我冲上去，把罐子塞进门缝。
lines.en: I rush in and wedge a jar in the gate crack.

lines.zh: 引线湿了，我用身体挡风。
lines.en: The fuse is damp. I shield it with my body.
Go, all of you! Don't stand here!

lines.zh: 我抱着罐子从雾里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the fog with the jar.
The fuse is already set.
I walk slowly so it won't jostle.
Someone has to do this job.
The jar is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 手上还是湿的，先看一圈。
lines.en: My hands are still wet, so first a look around.
No wind in the fog. That's good.
I head toward the wall.
My kin clear a path for me.
I hear a bell in the village.

lines.zh: 火星落到引线上，我赶紧拍掉。
lines.en: A spark reached the fuse. I slapped it out.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，第一件事是护住罐子。
lines.en: I fell, and my first act was to shield the jar.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我把罐子举高。
lines.en: Water rises. I hold the jar up.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵什么都听不见。
lines.en: The blast left my ears deaf to everything.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我手臂，罐子差点滑。
lines.en: Something hit my arm and the jar nearly slipped.
That light numbed my fingers.
Hunger makes my grip weak.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，我护着罐子趴下。
lines.en: Lightning struck beside me; I dropped over the jar.
Nowhere here to make a throw.
